claim: Planet Q rotates once on its axis in 7 Earth days.
evidence: The measured axial rotation period of Planet Q is 7 Earth days. Its solar-day cycle is 4 Earth days.
required_quote: The measured axial rotation period of Planet Q is 7 Earth days.
excluded_quotes: Its solar-day cycle is 4 Earth days.
gold_rationale: The axial measurement grounds the claim; illumination cycle is a different metric.

claim: Planet Q rotates once on its axis in 1 Earth day.
evidence: The measured axial rotation period of Planet Q is 7 Earth days. Its solar-day cycle is 1 Earth day.
required_quote: The measured axial rotation period of Planet Q is 7 Earth days.
excluded_quotes: Its solar-day cycle is 1 Earth day.
gold_rationale: A matching solar cycle cannot support an incompatible axial rotation claim.

claim: Device Q has a battery runtime of 8 hours.
evidence: Device Q has a measured battery runtime of 6 hours. Its expected useful lifetime is 8 years.
required_quote: Device Q has a measured battery runtime of 6 hours.
excluded_quotes: Its expected useful lifetime is 8 years.
gold_rationale: Useful lifetime is not battery runtime; use explicit incompatible runtime.
